SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_MONSTER_RELIC.d: Upon pickup, increase your Max HP by {MaxHpGain}. At the start of combat, gain {StrengthPower} Strength and lose {DexterityPower} Dexterity.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_MONSTER_RELIC.f: Didn't you once say you wanted to grow as tall as a telephone pole?
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_SEALED_BOOK_REL:
Whenever you play a Clow Card or Sakura Card, gain {ChargeGain} Magic Charge ({PowerChargeGain} for Powers).
At {ExtraEffectCost} Magic Charge, your next card with an Extra effect spends {ExtraEffectCost} to trigger it and enters its element state.
The Clow Cards wait in the sealed pages.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_SEALED_WAND_REL:
When a non-minion enemy dies, gain {ChargeGain} charge ({EliteBossExtraGain} more in Elite and Boss combats, {SealExtraGain} more if Seal lands the kill).
Once you reach {TriggerThreshold} charge, spend it at the start of your next turn to add {Cards} Turn into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Unplayed Turns carry over to later combats.
Each Sakura Card or Turn in your deck raises the charge needed by {TriggerIncrease}.
Next Turn needs {RemainingCharge} more charge.
A key-shaped wand that gathers the light needed to turn Clow into Sakura.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_STAR_WAND_RELIC:
Replaces Sealed Wand. When a non-minion enemy dies, gain {ChargeGain} charge. Gain {EliteBossExtraGain} additional charge in Elite and Boss rooms, and {SealExtraGain} additional charge if Seal dealt the killing damage.
At the start of the first turn after your charge reaches {TriggerThreshold}, spend {TriggerThreshold} charge and add {Cards} Turn into your [gold]Hand[/gold]; an unplayed Turn is kept for later combats.
Each Sakura Card or Turn in your deck increases the charge required for your next Turn by {TriggerIncrease}.
If you also obtain Cerberus and Yue, replace them and this relic with Ultimate Wand.
Next convert needs {RemainingCharge} more charge.
Star power answers the new incantation, and the wand changes with it.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_ULTIMATE_WAND_R:
Automatically replaces Star Wand, Cerberus, and Yue when you collect all three.
When a non-minion enemy dies, gain {ChargeGain} charge. Gain {EliteBossExtraGain} additional charge in Elite and Boss rooms, and {SealExtraGain} additional charge if Seal dealt the killing damage.
At the start of combat, if you have Sealed Book, gain {BattleStartMagicCharge} Magic Charge. For every {ElementTrigger} elemental Clow Cards or Sakura Cards you play, if you have Sealed Book, gain {ElementMagicCharge} Magic Charge.
At the start of your turn, upgrade {HandUpgrades} random {HandUpgrades:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Hand[/gold] and mark a random enemy. Marked enemies take {MarkDamageIncrease}% more attack damage until their turn starts.
At the start of the first turn after your charge reaches {TriggerThreshold}, spend {TriggerThreshold} charge and add {Cards} Turn into your [gold]Hand[/gold]; an unplayed Turn is kept for later combats. Each Sakura Card or Turn in your deck increases the charge required for your next Turn by {TriggerIncrease}.
Next convert needs {RemainingCharge} more charge.
The powers of sun, moon, and stars meet in one wand.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_DARKNESS_WAND_R:
Gain {Energy} Energy.
Whenever a non-minion enemy dies, your Sealed Wand, Star Wand or Sun-Moon-Star Wand gains {WandChargeGain} extra charge.
At the start of combat, ALL enemies gain {StrengthPower} Strength.
A wand created by Clow Reed and carried by Eriol Hiiragizawa, inheritor of his memories.
The first eligible Clow Card you play each combat triggers its Extra Effect for free.
Tomoyo's first battle costume for Sakura sends its cape streaming into the wind.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_PINK_TRANSFORMA: Playing Sakura Cards no longer shuffles Void into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
For the first time, the power of the stars transformed a Clow Card into a Sakura Card.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_FROG_RAINCOAT_R: For every {Trigger} cards that enter Memory, [gold]Remind[/gold] {Cards} at the start of your next turn.
Tomoyo prepared the perfect costume for a rainy-day card capture.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_SWORD_JADE_RELI: Release increases a card's non-damage, non-block numbers by {ReleasePercent}% instead of {BaseReleasePercent}%.
A jade pendant that carries the Li family's sword spirit.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_TEDDY_BEAR_RELI: Whenever you play a Spell other than Empty Spell, gain {Block} Block.
A handmade bear stitched with a wish to protect.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_ROLLER_SKATES_R: At the start of your turn, if you have less than {MaxDexterity} Dexterity, gain {DexterityGain} Dexterity.
They make every awkward dash look almost planned.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_TOUYAS_BICYCLE_: Whenever you exhaust a Void, if you have Sealed Book, gain {MagicCharge} Magic Charge.
Touya's bike keeps arriving exactly when Sakura needs to move.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_TAOIST_SUIT_REL: Every {Trigger} Clow Cards or Sakura Cards you play, add {Cards} Empty Spell into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Syaoran's battle clothes are cut for sharp steps and sharper spells.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_YUKITOS_BENTO_B: If you ended your last turn with 0 Energy, gain {Energy} Energy at the start of this turn.
Yukito packed enough for everyone, somehow.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_COMPASS_RELIC.d:
At the start of combat, choose up to {ChoiceLimit} of {Cards} random Clow Cards. Add them into your [gold]Hand[/gold] and deck; they cost {CombatCost} this turn.
If you chose any, add {VoidCount} Void into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_COMPASS_RELIC.f: The needle points toward a card before Sakura knows its name.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_GEM_BROOCH_RELI: Remove duplicate Clow Sword and Clow Shield cards from your deck, then upgrade the retained cards.
The scattered shape of Sword, gleaming with a will that can overwhelm its wearer.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_TOMOYOS_HEART_R: Every {Trigger} cards you exhaust, draw {Cards} card.
Tomoyo's camera sees courage before Sakura can.
At the start of combat, if you have Sealed Book, gain {BattleStartMagicCharge} Magic Charge.
At the start of your turn, mark a random enemy. It takes {MarkDamageIncrease}% more attack damage until its turn starts.
If you also have Star Wand and Yue, all three merge into Sun-Moon-Star Wand.
The guardian of the seal is small only when he wants snacks.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_YUE_RELIC.title: Yue
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_YUE_RELIC.descr:
For every {Trigger} elemental Clow or Sakura Cards you play each turn, gain {MagicCharge} Magic Charge if you have Sealed Book.
At the start of your turn, upgrade {Cards} random {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
If you also have Star Wand and Cerberus, all three merge into Sun-Moon-Star Wand.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_YUE_RELIC.flavo: Moonlight answers only to judgment earned.
SAKURA_MOD_RELIC_CLASSIC_MOON_BELL_RELIC:
Whenever you play a card with base cost {TriggerCost} or more, heal {Heal} HP.
The first time you would die, heal {DeathPreventHealPercent}% of your Max HP instead and add Turn into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. An unplayed Turn carries over to later combats.
A bell from the moon shrine that rings only at the edge of loss.
